faq.title: Inquiries

faq.items.q: Q: What do I do if I encounter a bug?
faq.items.a: A: If you encounter a bug, please contact me via Twitter, email, or Discord.
A: Yes, send me a message and I will consider the idea and its complexity.

faq.items.q: Q: How do I apply the patch for a Pokémon mod?
faq.items.a: A: You can apply it at RomPatcher.js. Please note that you should use a ROM of your own whose sha1 matches the version for which the mod was designed. If the game is in English, the ROM should be the USA version; if it's completely in Spanish, it should be the ESP version.

faq.items.q: Q: How do I apply the patch for a Ratchet & Clank mod?
faq.items.a: A: To apply the Ratchet & Clank mods, you will need to download racman and follow its instructions to use it with your legally acquired PS3 HD collection ROM, whether you want to play it on a PS3 or the RPCS3 emulator. Once you have it set up, drag the folder of my mod into the mods folder of racman in the corresponding game. NPEA00385 is Ratchet & Clank 1, NPEA00386 is Ratchet & Clank 2, NPEA00387 is Ratchet & Clank 3, and NPEA00423 is Ratchet Gladiator.

faq.items.q: Q: How do I apply the patch for a Deltarune mod?
faq.items.a: A: To apply the Deltarune mods, you will need to download DeltaPatcher and apply the .xdelta patch of the mod to the data.win file of the corresponding chapter. The data.win files for each chapter are usually located in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\DELTARUNE.
